_comment: future-work.md's no-progress guard (turn.go) — two consecutive steps with no content, no tool calls, and status!=done mean the model is stuck. This must surface as a genuine turn failure (turns.status='failed', a visible failTurn notice), never as a silent 'completed' turn with nothing delivered — the harness must be as vocal as possible about a real failure, but the visible text is a system notice about the failure, never a fabricated stand-in for what the model would have said.
